settings.description: Get into the first early-access group.

settings.question: When can I buy?
settings.answer: List: Saturday 10.10 at 20:00. Everyone: Sunday 11.10 at 20:00 (Italian time).

settings.question: Do you ship across the EU?
settings.answer: Yes, across the whole EU. Costs and delivery times per country at checkout.

settings.question: Can I return my order?
settings.answer: Yes — see the 14-day right of withdrawal below.

settings.question: How does the 14-day right of withdrawal work?
settings.answer: You have 14 days from delivery to withdraw and send the item back for a refund.

settings.question: Where can I find the size guide?
settings.answer: Every piece has its own size guide, linked on its product page.

settings.question: Are measurements provided in centimetres?
settings.answer: Yes, every size guide is in centimetres.
